description: This file contains unit tests for the ConnectionCreated class related to connectivity events in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes tests for equality, immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and resource path retrieval.

classes.name: ConnectionCreatedTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ConnectionCreated, testing equality, immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and resource path logic.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the equality and hash code implementations of ConnectionCreated using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ConnectionCreated and related classes are immutable.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullConnection
methods.description: Tests that attempting to create ConnectionCreated with null parameters throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the fromJson method correctly deserializes a JSON object into a ConnectionCreated instance.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson method serializes a ConnectionCreated instance correctly.

methods.name: getResourcePathReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getResourcePath returns the correct JsonPointer.
